keyFindings.description: Line 1954, the /v1/messages/publish row: says bus.publishCoreTo refuses a cancelled ctx 'reading it at entry and again once the connection is usable' and that publishConfirmed refuses only a spent deadline. 98fa1cc6 removed both reads; publishConfirmed's single ctx check (confirm.go:41-48) now sees both a spent deadline and a cancel.
Lines 122-127 say the same as the AGENTS.md row: publishConfirmed checks its deadline, and publishCoreTo refuses a cancelled ctx by reading it once more after a reconnect wait. False since 98fa1cc6.
Line 1893, the role-ownership bullet: names `withinContext`, which b2ed891c deleted. The bound is now store.Registry's (`bounded`, used by RoleClaim and ReleaseExpiredRoleClaim).

The comment on TestAPublishConfirmedWithASpentDeadlinePublishesNothing (lines 125-127) says a ctx reaches publishConfirmed ended only when it ended during or just after the wait for a connection. With publishCoreTo's entry read gone, an already-ended ctx reaches it on every core publish over a healthy connection (ensureConnWithContext returns nil without consulting ctx), which TestAPublishWithAnEndedContextSendsNothing drives end to end.
